__doc__: SOT-1421/P6 optional deploy-command map for redeploy_after_merge.sh. Keys are a repo slug (owner/name) or a project name (from project_repos.json); values are the shell deploy command run in the repo's localPath after a merge. Empty by default = every merge skips redeploy (best-effort). Deploy stays OFF unless REDEPLOY_ENABLED is truthy AND a command is configured. Keys starting with __ are ignored.
